title: #smallpoems #clmooc Amazing how fast meaning shifts stating "I can't" So definite. Yet add a Why meaning flies When "Why can't I" rolls off the tongue
summary: #smallpoems #clmooc Amazing how fast meaning shifts stating "I can't" So definite. Yet add a Why meaning flies When "Why can't I" rolls off the tongue unlimited possibilities untwist from time Power fed to the powerless All in three letters W-H-Y
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#smallpoems #clmooc
Amazing how
fast meaning
shifts
stating "I can't"
So definite.
Yet add a Why
meaning flies
When "Why can't I" rolls off the tongue
unlimited possibilities
untwist from time
Power fed to the powerless
All in three letters
W-H-Y
